name: A burn
prompt: You reach across the flat-top for the spatula, and the inside of your forearm touches the edge.

choices.text: Hold it under cold water for ten minutes

outcome.told: The burn stays a pink stripe. The tickets wait while you stand at the sink.

choices.text: Keep cooking and see to it after

outcome.told: It blisters by the end of the shift, but the line keeps moving.

failure.told: Within the hour the blister has opened. The owner sends you home to get it seen to.
